dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.soa.1: Slow down, Lucy. Did you actually see her, or did another one of your hunches start sprinting.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.lucy.1: I saw her, I saw her, I saw her. First the flowers moved wrong, then a braid, then nothing, then her again. Completely ordinary.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.soa.2: That was not ordinary. It was enough. If someone goes, they go carefully and without crowding her.
dialogue.lucy.scene.ambient.lucy.2: Exactly. That's why I sketched it fast before I lost it, fixed it, or started three more versions on top.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line1: You. Listen. Quickly, no, slowly, but listen. I saw a very strange young woman in a nearby clearing.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line2: She was not asking for help. She was like... hidden in plain sight. Still for a second, gone the next. It worried me. A lot.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line3: Do not treat this like a rescue. Approach calmly, give her space, and look before you speak.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.line4: Take the sketch. I marked it while my hands were shaking, so follow the needle, but use your eyes too.
dialogue.lucy.scene.clue.received: Lucy jams a crumpled sketch into your hands before moving again.
dialogue.lucy.scene.replacement.line1: You lost the sketch. Knew that could happen. I made another one. I think this one vibrates less.
dialogue.lucy.scene.replacement.line2: If you stomp into the clearing making noise, I'm telling everyone Soa sent you alone.
dialogue.lucy.scene.repeat.line1: You already have the sketch. Stop shaking it. It will not run faster than you.
dialogue.lucy.scene.after_discovery.line: Well, no more sketch duty then. The girl in the clearing is not just a rumor anymore, right?
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_intro.line1: If Lucy stopped you dead to talk, then this matters.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_intro.line2: Go to the clearing if you must, but do not walk in like you're rescuing someone. Observe first.
dialogue.lucy.scene.soa_repeat.line1: You already know the important part. Steady head, light steps, and do not crowd her.
